plugins.name: adb-mcp
plugins.description: Drive an Android emulator or device over adb: screenshot, inspect UI, tap, type, build and test.

skills.name: build-and-test
skills.description: Mapping a multi-module Gradle project before guessing a task name, building a variant, running JVM vs on-device tests, and turning a JaCoCo coverage report into the specific lines that need a test. Use when building, testing, or checking coverage for an Android/Gradle project.
skills.description_zh: 用于 Android/Gradle 项目构建、测试和覆盖率检查，先梳理多模块任务与构建变体，区分 JVM 与设备测试，并将 JaCoCo 覆盖率报告定位到需要测试的具体代码行。

skills.name: crash-triage
skills.description: Using logcat to surface the real "Caused by:" root cause hidden behind a generic UI error, plus app lifecycle tools for reproducing failures. Use when an app crashes, shows a generic error dialog, or a task needs to find why a native call failed.
skills.description_zh: 使用 logcat 定位通用界面错误背后的 Caused by 根因，并借助应用生命周期工具复现崩溃或原生调用失败。

skills.name: driving
skills.description: The core observe→locate→act→re-observe loop for driving an Android UI with adb-mcp — true-pixel coordinates, and gotchas like overlays eating taps, keyboards covering buttons, and settle delays. Use whenever tapping, swiping, typing, or otherwise interacting with an Android screen.
skills.description_zh: 通过 adb-mcp 按观察、定位、操作、复查循环控制 Android 界面，涵盖真实像素坐标、遮罩吞点击、键盘遮按钮和界面稳定等待等注意事项。

skills.name: getting-started
skills.description: How to list AVDs, boot an emulator, target a device with the serial argument, and run a first interaction with adb-mcp. Use when starting a new Android automation task, or when no device/emulator is booted yet.
skills.description_zh: 指导 adb-mcp Android 自动化入门，包括列举 AVD、启动模拟器、按 serial 指定设备并进行首次交互，适用于尚无运行设备的情况。

skills.name: pin-and-lock
skills.description: Entering digits on native (non-IME) PIN pads, and setting/clearing a secure lock screen required by AndroidKeyStore / Keystore-backed crypto flows. Use when a task needs to unlock a device, enter a PIN, or set/clear a device lock.
skills.description_zh: 处理 Android 原生非输入法 PIN 键盘及安全锁屏的设置/清除，适用于设备解锁、输入 PIN 或 AndroidKeyStore/Keystore 加密流程所需的锁屏配置。

skills.name: rn-expo
skills.description: The RN/Expo dev-build recipe for adb-mcp — adb_reverse before launching (or the dev client silently runs its embedded bundle), app_state to confirm it is on Metro, on the RIGHT Metro, and not serving stale JavaScript after a git checkout, then reload_app. Use whenever driving a React Native or Expo dev build, or when code edits appear to have no effect on the device.
skills.description_zh: 指导 adb-mcp 操作 React Native/Expo 开发构建，先配置 adb_reverse，再用 app_state 核对正确 Metro 服务和最新 JavaScript，最后 reload_app，排查代码变更未在设备生效的问题。
